methods.control: Physical keyboard/mouse events; closed-loop steering reads live vehicle state. Phase transitions place a vehicle with explicit test hooks; creative controls set weather/wanted/invulnerability, save/load and fast travel. Every hook placement/recovery is logged.
methods.frameTimes: Raw milliseconds between Babylon onAfterRender observer callbacks. Includes running creative overlay rendering; map/pause rendering also retained and marked paused in resource samples. This measures delivered render callbacks, not display presentation or GPU execution time.
methods.memory: CDP Performance JSHeapUsedSize/TotalSize and DOM counters; Babylon live mesh/body/material/multiMaterial/texture/geometry counts. No forced GC. GPU allocation and whole-process RSS unavailable in this sandbox.
methods.concurrency: One harness GPU browser at a time; other agents may edit source or run CPU checks. Served build stays frozen.
